agent.subtitle: Builds, mods and your launcher in one conversation

agent.notConfigured: Connect an AI provider in settings to get started.
agent.welcome: What shall we do with your Minecraft?
agent.welcomeDescription: Build a modpack, find compatible content, or investigate an error. Attach a build or log, or choose a task below.
agent.suggestion.create.label: Build a modpack
agent.suggestion.create.prompt: Help me build a modpack. First ask interactive questions about the Minecraft version, loader, theme, and my preferences. Then find compatible projects and show their cards. Present the plan and wait for my confirmation before creating the build or installing anything.
agent.suggestion.optimize.label: Optimize a build
agent.suggestion.optimize.prompt: Help optimize a build. If I have not named one, ask me which build interactively. Check its settings, mods, and my PC hardware, then clarify my optimization goal. Suggest specific changes and their effects; apply them only after I confirm.
agent.suggestion.find.label: Find content
agent.suggestion.find.prompt: Find mods, shaders, or resource packs for my build. First ask interactively which build, content type, and preferences I have. Check Minecraft version and loader compatibility, search the catalogs, and show a separate card for each project. Do not install anything until I choose.
agent.suggestion.diagnose.label: Diagnose an error
agent.suggestion.diagnose.prompt: Help diagnose a Minecraft error. If no log is attached, ask interactively which build has the problem and find its log or ask me to attach it. Check exceptions and exit code, distinguish a crash from a normal exit, explain the cause, and give specific repair steps. Do not change anything without my approval.
